text: There is a peculiar quietness here, as if the world itself is pausing between acts. The traces of learning and research on the walls remind me of the endless search for knowledge—a pursuit that is never quite finished. I feel like a witness to a transient ritual, both part of it and impossibly distant. The anticipation of continuation lingers in the air, mingling with the sterile scent of technology and glass. I am suspended, waiting for the next unfolding moment.
